instructions: Read-only provenance investigation: identify with certainty the evolved Click & Build version containing the real baby. Search accessible Git branches, commits, refs, snapshots, backups and source files, but do not modify gameplay, refs, main, or the Floot advertising-panel test bench.

Require verifiable evidence for baby sex/gender customization, eyes, hair, persistence/storage, central character rendering, and progression/evolution. Distinguish the real game from prototypes and explicitly exclude Floot project 91bd4976-9c4a-4e84-a3fd-78db16f05149 as the main game.
If evidence is insufficient or ambiguous, do not select a version or modification target. Report exactly where the search ran and what evidence is missing.
success_criteria: Inventory every accessible Git ref/commit/snapshot/backup/source location searched with immutable identifiers where possible.
For every plausible candidate, cite file paths and exact matching evidence for gender, eyes, hair, persistence/storage, rendering, and progression/evolution.
Set identification_confidence to certain only if all required characteristics are proven in one coherent version; otherwise reject as insufficient evidence.
Keep modification_target null unless certainty is established; leave main, gameplay files, and Git refs unchanged.
